Welcome to WaveHeaven
WaveHeaven keeps your music audible over the noise around you, and keeps count of the sound your ears receive so you stay within a safe dose.
WaveHeaven is not a medical device. If you notice ringing, muffled hearing or pain, see an audiologist.
Get started
What WaveHeaven measures
How loud it is around you, once per second, with the microphone, only while music plays and adaptive volume is on.
Never your voice or any audio. Sound becomes a loudness number on this device and is discarded at once. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent.
One summary per minute of listening: how loud your music and your surroundings were. It stays on this device for 30 days and is not included in backups.
You can stop it at any time from the notification, and delete your data in Settings.
Your consent

How much sound your ears receive says something about your hearing health, so Colombian law (Ley 1581 de 2012) treats it as sensitive health data. To measure it, WaveHeaven needs your explicit consent to process the loudness of your surroundings and of your music, only on this device and only to estimate your listening dose. Consent is optional: without it the app still works as a dose explorer. You can withdraw it at any time in Settings.
I agree to WaveHeaven processing this data as described.
Accept
Not now
How strict should your weekly limit be?
WHO standard
40 hours a week at 80 dB(A). Recommended for adults.
WHO sensitive
40 hours a week at 75 dB(A). For children, teenagers or anyone who wants a stricter limit.
You can change this later in Settings.
Microphone access
Your device will now ask for access to the microphone. WaveHeaven uses it only to measure how loud it is around you.
Allow microphone
Microphone access is allowed. You can start adaptive volume from the home screen.
Without the microphone WaveHeaven cannot adapt the volume, but you can still see your dose and explore safe listening times. You can allow it later in the system settings.
